description: This file is a shell script that defines tests for Git diff commands and their behaviors, including setup, execution, and validation of various diff scenarios.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success based on the provided commands.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Checks that a command returns the specified exit code.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the provided command fails.
